PLAY · STORY ORDER ON A JOURNEY

Butterfly’s Story Journey

Butterfly visits the pond, the forest, the flower field, and the sunny meadow. Draw a line along the journey stops in order — and skip the places a butterfly would never go!

GOOD TO KNOW

While you draw.

A lovely stop on the journey!

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear appear right here and work straight on the picture. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This adventure is cleared for you the moment you save your finished picture. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! What a journey! Your saved work is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in the library.

REACTIONS

How did it go?

One tap, no writing, no name. Pick the face that matches how it went — reactions are counted instantly and stay anonymous.

PARENT REVIEWS

Parent reviews.

A different thing from the quick faces above: a star rating for the grown-ups, plus an optional line about how it went.

      FOR GROWN-UPS

      Why this adventure helps.

      Journey games train story ORDER plus common sense: butterflies visit ponds and meadows, never bedrooms. The three indoor stops answer with a giggle and never a penalty.

      Prefer paper? The Butterfly’s Story Journey worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
